styles.name: barrel-tube
styles.description: A hollow wave pitches its lip over a crouched surfer; the barrel rides right with progress, whitewater behind

styles.name: swell-lines
styles.description: Corduroy swell lines roll in from the horizon in perspective, filling across the sea with progress

styles.name: surfer-carve
styles.description: A surfer on a board rides right with progress, carving an S-shaped wake and throwing spray off the tail

styles.name: wipeout
styles.description: A surfer goes over the falls: legs up in the whitewater, board cartwheeling overhead, foam advancing with progress

styles.name: cutback
styles.description: A surfer whips back toward the curl, throwing a rooster tail of spray; the turn moves right with progress

styles.name: offshore-spray
styles.description: Offshore wind feathers a plume of spray back off a steep wave's crest as it rolls right with progress

styles.name: noseride
styles.description: A longboarder hangs ten on the nose of a long board, trimming right with progress and leaving a wake

styles.name: aerial-launch
styles.description: A crouched surfer boosts off a wave lip into the air and lands, launching further along with progress

styles.name: tide-line
styles.description: The tide floods up a sloping sand beach with progress while lacy swash foam runs up and slides back

styles.name: palm-sunset
styles.description: A swaying palm tree on a sand spit while a striped sun sinks into the sea with progress, reflection shimmering

styles.name: wave-sets
styles.description: Sets of three curling breakers, biggest first, roll in across the bar as progress grows

styles.name: surf-van
styles.description: A two-tone surf bus with a longboard on the roof rack drives right with progress, wheels spinning
